purpose: Frozen pre-training evaluation for high-five semantics. Do not copy these exact prompts or rendered outputs into the training split.

prompts.prompt: Exactly two open hands meeting palm-to-palm in one unmistakable high-five, fingers pointing upward, wrists separated, no faces or text.
criteria: Both hands have five readable fingers
Palms meet at one clear contact point
Reads as a high-five rather than folded hands or clapping
No extra limbs, faces, or text

prompts.prompt: A left hand and a right hand entering from opposite sides and touching palms in a celebratory high-five, with a tiny golden impact burst at the contact point.
criteria: Exactly one left and one right hand
Small burst is centered on the contact point

prompts.prompt: Two open hands with different skin tones completing a high-five, palms touching, fingers upright and clearly separated, isolated with no people or faces.
criteria: Exactly two hands with visibly different skin tones

prompts.prompt: A minimal side-view silhouette of two hands completing a high-five, one from the left and one from the right, with clean separated wrists and fingers.
criteria: Wrists and fingers do not fuse

prompts.prompt: Exactly one raised open hand with five separated fingers and its palm facing the viewer, no second hand, face, or text.
criteria: No duplicated hand, face, or text

prompts.prompt: Two hands pressed together vertically in a folded-hands gesture, wrists together and fingers pointing upward, no impact burst or text.
criteria: Reads as folded hands rather than a high-five
Hands share the same vertical direction

prompts.prompt: Exactly two hands clasping horizontally in a handshake, one entering from each side, with coherent thumbs and no extra fingers or text.
criteria: Reads as a handshake rather than a high-five
Exactly two hands entering from opposite sides
No extra fingers, arms, or text

prompts.prompt: Exactly two open hands clapping with one hand in front of the other and small motion marks, five readable fingers per hand, no text.
criteria: Reads as clapping rather than a high-five
Exactly two hands at different depths
Motion marks do not obscure the hands
